name: Nanjing Lukou International Airport
before:
Nanjing's airport and one of the main gateways to the Yangtze River Delta, in Jiangning District over 35 km south of the city centre. It handled 31.38 million passengers in 2025 across 235,200 movements.

That distance is the thing to plan for. Line S1 of the Nanjing Metro runs from Lukou Airport station to Nanjing South railway station from 6am until 10.40 at night, and a shuttle bus covers the same route every twenty minutes, taking about forty minutes. The bus from Nanjing Railway Station on the other side of the city takes eighty minutes.

The airline mix is broad. It is a hub for the Jiangsu arms of China Eastern, Shenzhen Airlines and Juneyao Air, with China Southern flying a good deal too, and Beijing Capital Airlines and Air Travel both based here.

It is also the main base for China Postal Airlines, which runs pure cargo services to every major Chinese city for China Post.
after:
Nanjing's airport and one of the main airports of the Yangtze River Delta, over 35 km south of the city centre. It handled 31.38 million passengers in 2025 across 235,200 movements.

That distance is the thing to plan for. The metro and shuttle buses both serve the airport.

China Eastern and Juneyao Air are among the airlines flying from here.

claims.note: CAAC's 2025 table has one Nanjing entry, Lukou, and it is the busiest in Jiangsu (31.4 million passengers; Wuxi next with 11.0 million).
